implemented: Effective-dated, source-hash-bound stock splits preserve total book basis, reject fractional-share outcomes, and invalidate pre-split marks until a new mark is recorded.
Cash dividends validate historical pre-ex-date holdings from dated fills and splits, post gross income, owner-supplied withholding tax and net cash exactly once, and survive restart.
Sourced suspension/resumption events block new intents while suspended.
Sourced delisting cash recovery posts proceeds and realizes gains/losses against position basis; zero recovery is supported.
Corporate actions require stable IDs and source hashes; conflicting action IDs and invalid events fail without mutating the journal.
blockers: Source hashes and supplied rates are not independently checked against an official corporate-action provider or tax authority; no real source feed is configured.
Fractional split entitlements require a sourced cash-in-lieu workflow and are currently refused.
Delisting settlement models only owner-supplied gross cash recovery; event-specific tax, legal settlement, symbol succession and non-cash demerger/rights mechanics remain unsupported.
scope_note: This is paper-only long cash-equity accounting and does not assert completeness for all Indian corporate-action mechanics.
